init.title: Nilan Connect
init.description: Change the unit's settings, or map it.

settings.title: Level of values
settings.description:
Choose which of the unit's values get an entity.

- **Verified**: only values read on a unit of this model.
- **Documented**: also values from the manufacturer's documentation. This is the default.
- **Test**: every value, also those inferred from the order of Nilan's manual, and values tried in place of others or new. They have not been confirmed on a unit of this model: they may be wrong, and changing one may change a different setting. If you test, please [report]({report_url}) whether they match your unit's panel.

data_description.level: Each entity's attribute Certainty says how certain its value is.

map_start.title: Map the unit
map_start.description:
Mapping finds out what the unit's registers mean, with your help. You make one change at a time on the unit's own panel or in the manufacturer's app, and after each the integration reads the unit and shows what changed. Nothing is written to the unit.

First the integration reads every register of the unit once. The first read can take a minute or two; every read after it takes a few seconds.

When you are done, download the diagnostics and attach them to a [mapping report]({report_url}).

data.unit: Which unit is it, and what is fitted?

data_description.unit: Such as: Genvex Optima 399, bought in 2019, with an after-heating coil and a heat pump.

map_change.title: Make one change

data.change: What did you change, and what does the panel show now?

data_description.change: Such as: Opened the bypass damper. Room 1 shows 21.5 °C.

map_changed.title: What changed

map_done.title: Done
map_done.description: Every step is stored. A last read of everything finds registers that appeared during the mapping; it takes as long as the first read.

progress.reading: Reading the unit. The first read can take a minute or two; closing this stops it, and every step already taken stays stored.

error.read_failed: The unit was busy or did not answer, so the read stopped. Try again in a moment.

abort.not_loaded: The unit is not set up right now, so it cannot be mapped. Try again once it is.
abort.mapping_saved_without_full_read: The mapping is stored, but the last read of everything stopped: the unit was busy or did not answer.

testing_points.title: {name} tests values not confirmed on a {model}
testing_points.description:
{name} uses the Test level: some of its values are inferred from the order of Nilan's manual or tried in place of others, and have not been confirmed on a {model}. Please [report]({report_url}) whether they match your unit's panel, and attach the diagnostics, which list them.

To stop testing, choose another level in the options of Nilan Connect; this message then goes away.
